cs.t:
Sleep:
- wax earplugs
- buckwheat pillow
- a pillow that goes between my knees (I'm a side sleeper) Above combo has made 6 hour sleep feel like 8 hours and 8 hours feel like I can go the rest of my life without sleep in the morning Fitness:
- gymnastic rings: ultraportable and ultrascalable (from arthretic grandma level to olympic athlete level) workout. I have two pairs and I'm thinking about buying another one. Fun:
- someone already mentioned minecraft lol
- wireless buds, I have Jlabs go air pop and I sometimes prefer them over my trusty Sennheisers HD 600
- Ibanez rg565 genesis desert yellow (add another 0 to 100 dollars but I bought it in installments so, technically, I paid less than 100 dollars for it per month, worth it, you can shred the absolute fuck out of it) Health:
- good sunglasses (cat 3 or even better cat 4)
- omega 3 and vitamin d : important if you live in unhabitable, gray and cold regions of earth (like eastern europe) Education:
- Anki, free for pc and android, cheap for iphones
